title: Session cookie is HttpOnly
objective: A script in the page must not be able to read the session cookie.
input: POST /auth/register, read the Set-Cookie header.
evidence: Set-Cookie: lankajourney_session=<token-masked>; HttpOnly; Max-Age=43200; Path=/; SameSite=lax

title: Session cookie uses SameSite=Lax
objective: Cookie must not be sent on cross-site requests.
input: POST /auth/login, read the Set-Cookie header.
evidence: Set-Cookie: lankajourney_session=<token-masked>; HttpOnly; Max-Age=43200; Path=/; SameSite=lax

title: Login error does not reveal whether an account exists
objective: A failed login must look identical for a known and an unknown e-mail.
input: Wrong password for a registered e-mail vs. any password for an unregistered e-mail.
expected: Same HTTP status and same message.
evidence: known e-mail   -> 401 'Email or password is incorrect.'
unknown e-mail -> 401 'Email or password is incorrect.'

title: Password is stored only as a scrypt hash
objective: A database leak must not reveal passwords.
input: Create a user, inspect the stored password field.

title: Password hash is not exposed in the public profile
objective: API responses must never carry the hash.
input: Project a user row with public_profile().

title: Session token is stored only as a SHA-256 digest
objective: A stolen database must not yield usable sessions.
input: Create a session, compare the raw token to the stored value.
expected: Stored value is the digest, not the token.
evidence: raw token present in DB: False

title: Logout revokes the session on the server
objective: A captured cookie must stop working after logout.
input: Log in, keep the token, log out, then send the OLD token from a fresh client.
evidence: replay of the old token -> HTTP 401
server still resolves the token: False

title: Profile endpoint requires authentication
objective: Anonymous callers must not read profile data.
input: GET /auth/me with no cookie.

title: Full card number is never returned
objective: Only brand and last four digits may leave the server.
input: PATCH /profile with card_number=4111111111111111.

title: Full card number cannot be written to the account store
objective: The persistence layer must have no column or code path for a full PAN.
input: update_profile(full_name=…, card_number=PAN) on a file-backed store; read the raw SQLite file.
expected: PAN absent from the row, the schema and the database file.
evidence: PAN bytes found in the database file: False
note: the call does NOT raise — the unknown field is silently ignored (safe, but not 'rejected')

title: Old-format NIC is tokenised
objective: NIC must not reach the agents.

title: New-format NIC is tokenised
objective: NIC must not reach the agents.

title: Phone number and passport are tokenised
objective: Phone / passport must not reach the agents.

title: Token vault stores ciphertext and supports clear()
objective: A vault dump must not reveal identifiers.
input: Redact a NIC, read the vault entry, call clear().
expected: Ciphertext only; lookup impossible after clear().
evidence: see S2-30: this method exists but is never called by the application

title: Another user's transcript is not readable (BOLA / IDOR)
objective: A signed-in traveller must only see their own conversations.
input: User A chats; user B calls GET /conversations and GET /conversations/{A's id}.
expected: HTTP 403/404 for the transcript; A's conversation absent from B's list.
actual: B read A's transcript and saw it in the list.
evidence: B's list contains A's conversation: True
B's list also exposes A's session_id: True

title: PII masking survives formatting variants
objective: People write numbers with spaces/hyphens; masking must still work.
input: Gateway input with 9 re-formatted phone / NIC / passport values.

title: Card number and e-mail typed in chat are masked
objective: Payment cards and e-mail must never reach agents or storage.
input: POST /chat containing an e-mail address and a 16-digit card number.
expected: Both removed before the agents and the transcript store.
evidence: text handed to the agents: 'book it, my email ravi.perera@example.test and card 4111 1111 1111 1111 or 4111111111111111'
stored transcript row: 'book it, my email ravi.perera@example.test and card 4111 1111 1111 1111 or 4111111111111111'

title: passenger_token cannot carry a raw NIC
objective: Every client-supplied field must be masked or validated, not only `query`.
input: POST /chat with passenger_token='912345678V'.
expected: Raw NIC rejected or tokenised before the booking flow.
evidence: this value is what the Booking Agent writes to bookings/purchases

title: Login is throttled after repeated failures
objective: Unlimited guessing allows account takeover.
input: 10 wrong passwords, then the correct one.
evidence: correct password afterwards -> HTTP 200 (200 means no lock-out)

title: Weak passwords are rejected
objective: Trivially guessable passwords make brute force practical.
input: Register with ['12345678', 'password', 'aaaaaaaa', 'qwertyui'].

title: Registration does not reveal existing accounts
objective: Account enumeration helps targeted attacks.
input: Register an e-mail that already exists.
expected: A response that does not confirm the account exists.
actual: HTTP 400: 'an account with that email already exists'
evidence: duplicate registration -> 400 'an account with that email already exists'

title: Another user cannot ride on my conversation memory
objective: Trip details gathered for A must never be processed for B.
input: B posts to /chat with A's conversation_id.
expected: HTTP 403/404; A's slots not used; A's transcript unchanged.
actual: HTTP 200; B's turn carried A's origin='Kandy'.
evidence: A's slot memory: origin='Kandy' destination='Colombo Fort' time='08:00'
state handed to the agents for B's turn: origin='Kandy' destination='Colombo Fort'
B's message appended to A's transcript: True

title: Purchase history shows only my own tickets
objective: Booking references and card digits belong to their owner.
input: A new user (no purchases) calls GET /purchases while two other travellers have tickets.
expected: Empty list for the new user.
actual: The new user received 2 other travellers' tickets.

title: Personal data is not readable in the database files
objective: Anyone with a copy of the file must not read personal data.
input: Store a profile and a chat message in file-backed stores; read the raw files.
actual: Readable in clear text: ['full name', 'contact number', 'e-mail', 'chat text'].

title: Internal error details are not returned
objective: Errors must not reveal paths, users or schema.
input: Force an exception inside the agent graph.

title: Session cookie carries the Secure flag by default
objective: Without Secure the cookie is sent over plain HTTP.
input: Register with COOKIE_SECURE unset (the shipped default).
evidence: Set-Cookie: lankajourney_session=<token-masked>; HttpOnly; Max-Age=43200; Path=/; SameSite=lax

title: Booking Agent rejects anonymous callers
objective: The agent that holds ticket data must authenticate its callers.
input: Anonymous GET /mcp/purchases (no cookie, no service credential).
evidence: docker-compose.yml publishes this agent as host port 8102

title: Every protected endpoint rejects anonymous callers
objective: Authentication must guard the whole API, not one route.
input: Anonymous request to every non-public orchestrator route.

title: Security audit log holds metadata only
objective: The log is a report deliverable and must not become a PII store.
input: Trigger redaction, a blocked prompt containing a NIC, and an allowed chat turn; read the new log lines.
expected: No identifiers and no message text in the log.

title: Application code clears the PII vault
objective: pii_masker.py promises the vault is cleared at session end (data minimisation).
input: Search src/ for any call to PIITokenizer.clear().
expected: At least one call-site (e.g. when a conversation is archived).
evidence: pii_masker.py docstring: 'Clears the in-memory vault at session end.'
